title: 107 Graduates Prove It’s Never Too Late
description:
Every diploma tells a story of resilience, redemption, and hope.

Hear firsthand stories from graduates who overcame gang involvement, incarceration, teen parenthood, and other life challenges to pursue their education and build a new path forward. Their journeys are a testament to the life-changing support, second chances, and community found at Homeboy Industries.

At Homeboy Industries' graduation ceremony, 107 graduates celebrated milestones ranging from high school diplomas and career certificates to associate's and master's degrees. For many, this achievement represents far more than a diploma—it's proof that a difficult past does not define the future.
